question: According to the author, which of the following is a far higher gift than food and clothes, or even of life?
solution:
The correct answer is Knowledge.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the author, spiritual help and intellectual help are considered far more substantial than physical help.
 
• The text states that the gift of knowledge is far higher than that of food and clothes, or even life itself.
 
• It emphasizes that real life consists of knowledge, suggesting that knowledge is more enduring and valuable.
 
• Thus, knowledge is deemed a far higher gift than food and clothes, or even life, in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) Jobs:** The text does not mention jobs as a gift or compare it to the value of knowledge.
 
• **2) Food:** Although food is essential for physical well-being, it is not considered a higher gift than knowledge in the text.
 
• **4) Books:** While books may contain knowledge, the text specifically highlights knowledge itself as the highest gift.
